items.control_name: Enforce Conditional Access Policy: MFA for All Administrators
items.description: Entra ID Conditional Access must enforce phishing-resistant MFA for all administrative roles.
items.recommended_value: MFA enforced on 100% of admin roles with monitored break-glass exceptions
items.evidence_source: az ad policy conditional-access policy list
items.remediation_notes: Regularly test alert triggering on break-glass emergency account sign-ins.

items.control_name: Enforce Just-in-Time (JIT) Activation for Subscription Owner/Contributor Roles
items.description: No permanent Owner or Contributor assignments; administrators must activate access via PIM with ticket approval.
items.recommended_value: 0 permanent Owner assignments; enforce PIM JIT activation
items.remediation_notes: Convert permanent Owner assignments to Eligible PIM assignments with 8-hour max duration.

items.control_name: Block Legacy Authentication Protocols in Entra ID
items.description: Conditional Access policy must explicitly block legacy protocols (POP, IMAP, SMTP Auth, older Office clients).

items.control_name: Enforce Managed Identities over Client Secrets for Azure Resources
items.description: Azure VMs, App Services, and Functions must use User-Assigned or System-Assigned Managed Identities instead of client secrets.
items.current_value: 85% of services use Managed Identities; 3 App Services use client secrets
items.recommended_value: 100% adoption of Managed Identities for intra-Azure service authentication
items.remediation_notes: Migrate legacy App Service database connections to Managed Identity with Entra Auth.
